actions.capture_driver_and_device_identity: Record model, driver, device identity and workload context.
actions.correlate_same_device_logs: Review nearby events for this exact device and boot.
actions.inspect_application_failure: Review the failing workload with an appropriate application debugger.
actions.consider_vendor_diagnostics: Use vendor diagnostics under a separately approved workload plan.
actions.inspect_ecc_and_recovery_state: Read ECC counters and retirement/remapping state, preserving scope and timestamps.
actions.consult_vendor_recovery_guidance: Consult the linked device-specific recovery procedure before taking any action.
actions.inspect_link_and_peer_state: Collect link telemetry and peer-device evidence.
actions.inspect_pcie_events: Collect PCIe/AER evidence and identify the reporting device.
actions.consult_vendor_support: Provide the captured evidence to the hardware support organization.
actions.compare_same_scope_counter_snapshots: Compare timestamped snapshots; handle reset or wrap before calculating deltas.
actions.inspect_reported_ras_block: Verify the reported block and its supported RAS capabilities.
actions.map_reporting_device_to_topology: Identify the port/endpoint relationship before attributing a component failure.

rules.title: Compute exception
rules.summary: Compute execution fault; application, driver or hardware may be involved.

limitations: No subcode decoding or automated recovery policy.
